definition.simple: One tenth of a pip. It is the extra last digit many platforms show.
definition.balanced: Many brokers quote most pairs to 5 decimal places and yen pairs to 3. The last digit is a pipette, worth one tenth of a [[pip]]. A move of 10 pipettes is a move of 1 pip.

example: EUR/USD moving from 1.10000 to 1.10007 is a move of 7 pipettes, or 0.7 pips.
